changes: Every fresh ordinary run asks Start tutorial or Skip tutorial, regardless of any historical saved decision. Developer setup replacements do not inherit or repeat the choice.
Nonmodal nine-step guide observes real placements, legal keeper or merge, Start, Pause and Speed. Camera mouse/touch controls, Recipes and Enemy Waves are explained.
Escape skips the invitation; End tutorial or Escape ends the guide; Help can replay it. Reset, replacement and run end never record completion.

Replaying while blueprint editing displays a visible explanation and Return to blueprint, preserving all unsaved cells and editor history. Uncommitted Move is cancelled without CP or physical changes before replay.
Opening a modal book cannot satisfy the Pause step. Pausing and speed changes refresh the guide without a full gameplay UI render.
Touch-sized native buttons, keyboard isolation, visible focus return, internal scrolling and visual viewport bounds. The Enemy Waves header now uses the panel agent’s warband SVG.
preservation: No core combat, statistics, balance, progression, wave data or seeded-RNG implementation edits.
The tutorial never places a recruit, keeps or merges one, sets pause/speed or advances a clock automatically.
Historical tutorial decision remains recorded but never suppresses a fresh invitation.
